description: Find the commit that broke a test: binary-search the git history between a good and a bad commit, running the test at each step in a temporary worktree (your checkout is untouched), and report the first bad commit with its diff summary and failure. good defaults to the newest commit where the run history saw the test pass.

bad.description: A commit or ref where it fails (default HEAD)

good.description: A commit or ref where the test passed. Defaults to the newest commit in the run history where it passed

grep.description: Test title (or part of it) to run inside the file; keeps the search on one test

maxSteps.description: Most commits to test besides the two ends (default 12, enough for 4,000 commits)

project.description: Playwright project name to run in

projectRoot.description: Project directory (inside a git repository); defaults to the server working directory

repeat.description: Run the test this many times per commit; any failure marks the commit bad (default 1; raise it for a flaky failure)

stepTimeoutMs.description: Time limit for each test run (default 180000)

test.description: The failing spec file, e.g. "tests/cart.spec.ts" (a :line suffix also works, but lines move between commits; prefer grep)

name: bisect-failure

ok.description: false when the call failed (see error) or the tests it ran failed

title: Find the commit that broke a test
